sql: SELECT 'execucao' AS item, d.status AS valor, d.start_time::text AS inicio, round(extract(epoch FROM (d.end_time - d.start_time))::numeric, 1)::text AS segundos, left(d.return_message, 100) AS msg FROM cron.job_run_details d JOIN cron.job j ON j.jobid = d.jobid WHERE j.jobname = 'cleanup-technical-logs' UNION ALL SELECT 'raw_antigos', (SELECT count(*) FROM wapi_webhook_raw_events WHERE received_at < now() - interval '14 days')::text, NULL, NULL, NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'trace_antigos', (SELECT count(*) FROM message_trace_logs WHERE created_at < now() - interval '14 days')::text, NULL, NULL, NULL
